features.feature: Wide three-seat sofa with a low, rectangular upholstered body and two broad back cushions.
Two separate, thick back cushions, each with a horizontal seam across the front.
Broad upholstered seat with a visible vertical seam near the centre of the front edge.
Wide, slightly outward-angled arms with squared padded tops and visible stitched seams along the sides.
Medium brown-taupe woven upholstery and short tapered warm-brown wooden legs.
